Package com.univalle.fpoe.escriturarapida.model

Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
com.univalle.fpoe.escriturarapida.model.GameModel
public class GameModel extends Object
Game state and rules for "Escritura Rapida".

Notifies the registered GameListeners when a level starts, when the player succeeds or fails, and when the match ends. It does not depend on JavaFX.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Santiago Ruiz Vanegas

    • submitAnswer

      public void submitAnswer(String typedAnswer, double timeRemaining, boolean timedOut)
      Checks the player's answer for the current level.

      The comparison is exact (letters, spaces, case and punctuation). A wrong answer while there is still time left only reports the error, so the player can try again. The match ends only when the time runs out and the answer is wrong.

      Parameters:
      typedAnswer - text written by the player
      timeRemaining - seconds left on the clock
      timedOut - true if the check was triggered because the time ran out
